advisory: Synopsis: El Niño continues and will strengthen through the end of the year, with a 97% chance it will persist through early spring 2027.
forecast_summary: El Niño conditions are currently present with the latest weekly Niño-3.4 index at +1.2°C. This indicates moderate El Niño conditions. Models suggest a possibility of El Niño conditions developing later in the year. The probability chart below shows the seasonal forecast for La Niña (blue), Neutral (grey), and El Niño (red) conditions through the end of the year.
